why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: Check whether you're allowed. The terms exclude US residents and other groups, and the app's code lists the United States, Canada and all 27 EU countries as blocked regions. The terms add: "Use of a virtual private network (VPN) or any other technology to circumvent these restrictions is strictly prohibited."
Open app.nuva.finance and connect a wallet on Ethereum. The FAQ misprints the address as "app.nuva.finance.com", so type it yourself.
Hold the vault token, and watch the Points Hub for the start of Season 1.
